data.name: Ruheeba
data.gender_notes: Ruheeba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who is comforting and calming. The name Ruheeba carries the meaning “Comforting, calming” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ruheeba usually hope their child will grow to embody comforting, calming and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who will bring comfort and tranquility to her family and community
data.etymology: Ruheeba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Comforting, calming.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruheeba total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: روحيبة
in_arabic.meaning: روحيبة تعني الفتاة ذات الروح الخفيفة
in_arabic.long_meaning: روحيبة هي اسم علم مؤنث، مشتق من الفعل روح، ويعني الفتاة التي تمتلك روحًا خفيفة ومرحة، وقد وردت مشتقاته في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن الأرواح والروحانيات. يستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الفتاة التي تتميز بطبيعتها الخفيفة والمحببة.

in_urdu.name: روحیبا
in_urdu.meaning: روحیبا مطلب ہے ہلکی روح والی لڑکی
in_urdu.long_meaning: روحیبا ایک علم نام ہے جو روح سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے وہ لڑکی جس کی روح ہلکی اور خوشگوار ہے۔ اس نام کی اشتقاقیات العربية جڑوں سے ملتی ہیں اور اسلامی تقالید میں اس کا استعمال روحانی اور اندرونی خوبصورتی کو ظاہر کرنے کے لئے کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रुहैबा
in_hindi.meaning: रुहैबा का अर्थ है हल्की आत्मा वाली लड़की
in_hindi.long_meaning: रुहैबा एक सुंदर नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है हल्की आत्मा वाली या प्रेमपूर्ण स्वभाव वाली लड़की। इस नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक अच्छे और पवित्र नाम के रूप में किया जाता है, जो व्यक्ति की आध्यात्मिक और नैतिक सुंदरता को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: روحيبة
in_pashto.meaning: روحيبة معنی یې داسې نجلۍ ده چې رڼا روح لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: روحيبة د ښځینه اسم دی، چې د روح څخه اخیستل شوی دی، معنی یې هغه نجلۍ ده چې رڼا او خوشحاله روح لري. په پښتنو او افغانانو کې ددې نوم کارول داسې یوې نجلۍ لپاره دی چې ښه او مهربانه طبیعت لري.

in_english.name: Ruheeba
in_english.meaning: Ruheeba means a girl with a light and pleasant soul
in_english.long_meaning: Ruheeba is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic word 'ruh', meaning soul. It signifies a girl with a light, pleasant, and loving soul. The name has its roots in Islamic tradition and is used across various Muslim cultures to denote a girl with inner beauty, spiritual depth, and a charming personality.

In Islamic culture, names are often chosen based on attributes that one wishes for their child to possess. A name like Ruheeba can have a positive impact by encouraging those who bear the name to be sources of comfort and support for others, creating a more peaceful and loving community.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name Ruheeba holds a deeper significance, as it reminds us of the comforting and calming presence of Allah in our lives. As Muslims, we believe that Allah is always there for us, providing us with comfort and solace in times of distress, and guiding us towards the right path. The name Ruheeba serves as a constant reminder of this divine comfort and support, inspiring us to turn towards Allah in times of need and to be comforting and supportive of others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Comforting, calming" symbolizes She who is comforting and calming. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ruheeba serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of comforting, calming.
